pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal patches with high-angularity edges and irregular geometry. Patches on the upper neck and mid-flank exhibit sharp pixel-level transitions with a high dark-to-light spatial ratio, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes toward the ventral line.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily 3-way and 4-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the flank, with increased pixel width observed at nodes on the lower neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane is visible as a dark, short-bristled contour along the dorsal neck line. It exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations against the background, maintaining a relatively linear profile from the shoulder to the mid-neck.
